SFAuthorizationPluginView.doc: Allows authorization plug-in developers to create a custom view their plug-in can display.

SFAuthorizationView.doc: The class responsible for displaying a lock icon that can be used to indicate that a user interface has restricted access.

SFCertificatePanel.doc: A panel or sheet that displays one or more certificates.

SFCertificateTrustPanel.doc: A panel or sheet that lets the user edit the trust settings in any of the certificates in a certificate chain.

SFCertificateView.doc: A view that displays the contents of a certificate, with options to display certificate details, display trust settings, and allow users to edit a certificate’s trust settings.

SFChooseIdentityPanel.doc: A panel or sheet containing a list of identities that a user can choose from.

SFKeychainSavePanel.doc: A panel or sheet that allows the user to create a keychain.

SFKeychainSettingsPanel.doc: A panel or sheet that allows users to change their keychain settings.

SFAuthorizationViewState.doc: Defines the current state of the authorization view.

SFButtonType.doc: These constants define the button types used by authorization plug-ins.

SFViewType.doc: These constants define the view type requested by the authorization plug-in.

-buttonPressed:.doc: Tells the authorization plug-in that the user pressed a button in the custom view.

-callbacks.doc: Returns the authorization callbacks structure with which this instance was initialized.

-didActivate.doc: Tells the authorization plug-in when its user interface has become active.

-didDeactivate.doc: Tells the authorization plug-in that its user interface has been deactivated.

-displayView.doc: Displays the user interface provided by the authorization plug-in view subclass.

-engineRef.doc: Returns the authorization engine handle with which this instance was initialized.

-firstKeyView.doc: Returns the first view in the keyboard loop of the view.

-firstResponder.doc: Returns the view that should get focus for keyboard events.

-initWithCallbacks:andEngineRef:.doc: Initializes a new authorization plug-in view with the specified callbacks and authorization engine handle.

-lastError.doc: Returns the last error that occurred during evaluation.

-lastKeyView.doc: Returns the last view in the keyboard loop of the view.

-setButton:enabled:.doc: Enables or disables a button in the authorization plug-in’s user interface.

-setEnabled:.doc: Enables or disables the controls in the authorization plug-in’s view.

-updateView.doc: Tells the authorization plug-in to get and display the appropriate view in the authorization plug-in’s user interface.

-viewForType:.doc: Returns the appropriate view object for the specified view type.

-willActivateWithUser:.doc: Tells the authorization plug-in that its user interface is about to be made active by the Apple-provided Security Agent.

-authorization.doc: Returns the authorization object associated with this view.

-authorizationRights.doc: Returns the authorization rights for this view.

-authorizationState.doc: Returns the current state of the authorization view.

-authorize:.doc: Attempts to unlock the lock icon in the view.

-deauthorize:.doc: Sets the authorization state to unauthorized and locks the lock icon in the view.

-delegate.doc: Returns the delegate for this view.

-isEnabled.doc: Indicates whether the authorization view is enabled (true) or disabled (false).

-setAuthorizationRights:.doc: Sets the authorization rights for this view.

-setAutoupdate:.doc: Sets the authorization view to update itself automatically.

-setAutoupdate:interval:.doc: Sets the authorization view to update itself at a specific interval.

-setDelegate:.doc: Sets the delegate for this authorization view.

-setEnabled:.doc: Sets the current state of the authorization view.

-setFlags:.doc: Sets the current authorization flags for the view.

-setString:.doc: Sets the requested-right string to use with the default authorization rights set.

+sharedCertificatePanel.doc: Returns a fully initialized, singleton certificate panel object.

-beginSheetForWindow:modalDelegate:didEn.doc: Displays one or more certificates in a modal sheet.
Displays a certificate chain in a modal sheet.

-certificateView.doc: Returns the certificate view for the modal panel.

-helpAnchor.doc: Returns the current help anchor string for the sheet or panel.

-policies.doc: Returns an array of policies used to evaluate the status of the displayed certificates.

-runModalForCertificates:showGroup:.doc: Displays one or more specified certificates in a modal panel.

-runModalForTrust:showGroup:.doc: Displays a certificate chain in a modal panel.

-setAlternateButtonTitle:.doc: Customizes the title of the alternate button.

-setDefaultButtonTitle:.doc: Customizes the title of the default button.

-setHelpAnchor:.doc: Sets the help anchor string for the sheet or modal panel.

-setPolicies:.doc: Specifies one or more policies that apply to the displayed certificates.

-setShowsHelp:.doc: Displays a Help button in the sheet or panel.

-showsHelp.doc: Indicates whether the help button is currently set to be displayed.

+sharedCertificateTrustPanel.doc: Returns a fully initialized, singleton certificate trust panel object.

-beginSheetForWindow:modalDelegate:didEn.doc: Displays a modal sheet that shows the results of a certificate trust evaluation and that allows the user to edit trust settings.

-informativeText.doc: Returns the (optional) informative text currently displayed in the panel.

-runModalForTrust:message:.doc: Displays a modal panel that shows the results of a certificate trust evaluation and that allows the user to edit trust settings.

-setInformativeText:.doc: Sets the (optional) informative text displayed in the panel.

-certificate.doc: Returns the certificate currently displayed in the view.

-detailsDisclosed.doc: Returns whether the view currently shows the certificate’s details.

-detailsDisplayed.doc: Indicates if the view currently shows the certificate’s details.

-isEditable.doc: Indicates if the view allows the user to edit the certificate’s trust.

-isTrustDisplayed.doc: Indicates if the view currently shows the certificate’s trust settings.

-policies.doc: Returns an array of policies used to evaluate the status of the displayed certificate.

-policiesDisclosed.doc: Returns whether the trust policy subview is disclosed.

-saveTrustSettings.doc: Saves the user’s current trust settings for the displayed certificate.

-setCertificate:.doc: Specifies the certificate that’s displayed in the view.

-setDetailsDisclosed:.doc: Sets whether the certificate details subview is disclosed.

-setDisplayDetails:.doc: Specifies whether the user can see the certificate details.

-setDisplayTrust:.doc: Specifies whether the user can see the certificate’s trust settings.

-setEditableTrust:.doc: Specifies whether the user can edit the certificate’s trust settings.

-setPolicies:.doc: Specifies the policies to use when evaluating this certificate’s status.

-setPoliciesDisclosed:.doc: Specifies whether the trust policy settings subview is disclosed.

+sharedChooseIdentityPanel.doc: Returns a fully initialized, singleton choose identity panel object.

-beginSheetForWindow:modalDelegate:didEn.doc: Displays a list of identities in a modal sheet from which the user can select an identity.

-domain.doc: Returns the domain that will be associated with the chosen identity.

-helpAnchor.doc: Returns the current help anchor string for the sheet or panel.

-identity.doc: Returns the identity that the user chose in the panel or sheet.

-informativeText.doc: Returns the informative text currently displayed in the panel.

-policies.doc: Returns an array of policies used to evaluate the status of the displayed certificates.

-runModalForIdentities:message:.doc: Displays a list of identities in a modal panel.

-setAlternateButtonTitle:.doc: Customizes the title of the alternate button.

-setDefaultButtonTitle:.doc: Customizes the title of the default button.

-setDomain:.doc: Sets an optional domain in which the identity is to be used.

-setHelpAnchor:.doc: Sets the help anchor string for the sheet or modal panel.

-setInformativeText:.doc: Sets the optional informative text displayed in the panel.

-setPolicies:.doc: Specifies one or more policies that apply to the displayed certificates.

-setShowsHelp:.doc: Displays a Help button in the sheet or panel.

-showsHelp.doc: Indicates whether the help button is currently set to be displayed.

+sharedKeychainSavePanel.doc: Returns a shared keychain save panel object.

-beginSheetForDirectory:file:modalForWin.doc: Displays a sheet that allows a user to create a new keychain.

-error.doc: Returns the last error encountered by the keychain save panel.

-keychain.doc: Returns the keychain created by the keychain save panel.

-runModalForDirectory:file:.doc: Displays a panel that allows a user to create a new keychain.

-setPassword:.doc: Specifies the password for the keychain that will be created.

+sharedKeychainSettingsPanel.doc: Returns a shared keychain settings panel object.

-beginSheetForWindow:modalDelegate:didEn.doc: Displays a sheet that allows users to change keychain settings.

-runModalForSettings:keychain:.doc: Displays a panel that allows users to change keychain settings.
